content:
# Merge notes

The project was merged around the user's voice-only requirements rather than preserving full music-production UIs.

## Kept directly in the app

- MP3/WAV decode and feature analysis in JavaScript.
- Full merged slider schema.
- Permission/safety layer.
- Vocal-only prompt sanitizer and forced acapella tags.
- Backend generation/export request contract.
- WAV local export.
- Backend MP3 export path.

## Kept as backend/vendor support

- HeartMuse generation workflow and metadata concepts.
- YuE singing/acapella inference entry points.
- AEON export/mastering/conversion architecture.

## Not surfaced as UI features

- Instrumental song generation.
- Beat/instrument/genre workflows that imply backing tracks.
- Instrumental examples and demo audio.
- Finetuning/training scripts not necessary for runtime generation.
